principle: We represent communities with our own original drawings; we never copy logos or exact mascot art.

legend.ver: yes = cue read or seen today on a primary page, map avatar or X findings; partial = part seen, part recall or own site not reached; no = nothing read
legend.tier: A title hero, B loading and posters, C deep cuts
legend.risk: low generic object or colour; medium evokes protected mascot (draw our own); high needs owner permission

entries.name: BONK
entries.cue: Cartoon Shiba-type dog mascot, thumbs-up, in yellow #FFE208 / orange #FC8E03 / red #FF0000. Always "BONK" with exclamation marks. Kit says the dog has no mouth. Official card: shiba head in a yellow disc, red "!!" burst. Top-2 Solana memecoin ($301M).
entries.egg: A yellow-and-orange striped market awning with a red exclamation-mark pennant, and a mouthless sunny dog-shaped balloon tied to the stall. No disc badge, no red block letters.

entries.name: dogwifhat (WIF)
entries.cue: Shiba puppy photo wearing a chunky pink knitted beanie (CoinGecko token image; CoinGecko text: "a Shiba Inu dog wearing a pink knitted hat").
entries.egg: A small tan dog in a thick rose-pink knit hat sitting very still under a cafe table, staring at nothing. Different pose and breed look from the photo.

entries.name: Popcat (POPCAT)
entries.nickname: [Unverified] cat side of the cat/dog split
entries.cue: White-and-brown cat head with the mouth stretched into a huge round "O". Meme cat is named Oatmeal (CoinGecko). Official site card shows exactly that.
entries.egg: A brown-and-white cat in the bakery window, mouth a perfect round O, a ring doughnut hanging in front of it on a string.

entries.name: MEW (cat in a dogs world)
entries.cue: White cat standing triumphant on a pile of defeated shibas; slogan "For too long dogs have ruled the world"; red #E93323 and black site.
entries.egg: A small white cat standing on top of a stack of dog-food sacks, tail up, with a red banner behind. Dog plush toys lie flopped around it.

entries.name: Pudgy Penguins / PENGU
entries.cue: Chubby blue penguin, orange beak and feet, igloo village on snow, one penguin in a blue wizard hat (official card). Largest Solana memecoin today: $538M (CoinGecko). Pudgy runs licensing: [Unverified].
entries.egg: An igloo-shaped shaved-ice cart with a chubby blue penguin plush of our own design on the counter and a tiny wizard-hat penguin beside it.

entries.name: Moo Deng (MOODENG)
entries.cue: Chubby baby pygmy hippo, brown, pink open mouth. Real animal, born 10 Jul 2024 at Khao Kheow Open Zoo; name means "bouncy pork" (Wikipedia). Token art shows a hippo sitting on a moon-like rock.
entries.egg: A small brown hippo splashing in the town fountain, mouth open, with a steamed pork-bun cart beside it (bouncy pork).

entries.name: Peanut the Squirrel (PNUT)
entries.cue: Squirrel in a hat with a golden halo, peanuts, "Peanut forever" (official site). Memorial coin for a squirrel euthanised by NY authorities (Wikipedia, Meme coin).
entries.egg: A gentle grey-brown squirrel on a lamp-post bracket holding a peanut, a faint halo-shaped ring of light above it and a small candle below. Keep it kind, not a joke.

entries.name: Fartcoin
entries.cue: The logo is italic text "FARTCOIN" on black, not a picture. The hook is the fart joke and a "Gas Fee" fart sound (CoinGecko). Born from the Truth Terminal "Terminal of Truths" AI chat (link on its CoinGecko page).
entries.egg: A whoopee cushion on a cafe chair with one small pale puff above it. Only the joke is shown, no lettering.

entries.name: Gigachad (GIGA)
entries.cue: Black-and-white chiselled-jaw "Gigachad" face; token honours Ernest Khalimov, the man in the photo (CoinGecko). Real person, so do not copy the face.
entries.egg: A black-and-white gym-window poster of an invented square-jawed man in profile, with a protein shaker on the sill.

entries.name: Useless Coin (USELESS)
entries.cue: Golden-yellow round coin with a cream serif "U" (official site card).
entries.egg: A gold-painted flower pot or doorstop shaped like a coin with a cream capital U, holding a shop door open for nothing.

entries.name: Mad Lads

entries.name: Jupiter

Logo: slanted-band planet, lime #A9D36C to cyan #17B9D2 on black (jup.ag card).

placements.note: Sky is a soft purple (top) to warm teal-green (near the rooftops) sunset wash. No logo, no bars. The top centre stays flat, open gradient for the title.

Two short strings of bunting from the left lamp-post to the cafe roof and from the right clock tower to the right shops. Purple-and-yellow pennants mixed with many different country flags, one per chapter. Nothing crosses the top centre.
Pickaxe against the kerb on a 5x5 patch of copper-sheen paving tiles, with a wheelbarrow of ore. At the lower-left edge, outside the open centre ground.
Chunky black phone propped on the table with three lens dots and one engraved shield. A generic phone, not the device render. A coffee next to it.
Small tan dog in a thick rose-pink knit hat, very still, staring out. A tiny acting beat, not a second hero.
JUPCAT: a small white cat in a white-and-blue astronaut suit and bubble helmet, napping on the sill, banded-planet patch on the sleeve. It is the softest, warmest detail on the left.
A friendly purple ghost in our own style peeks from behind the lamp-post. Own silhouette and face; keep it clearly different from their logo.
Brown-and-white cat in the window, mouth a round O, ring doughnut on a string in front of it.
Small arched round hall behind the cafe roofs with a blackletter ENTER banner. Anchors the top-left skyline and leaves the top centre open.
Fountain and the acting characters. No egg here. The lower-centre ground in front stays clear cobblestone for buttons.
Orange neon "faster" sign over the bike-courier shop. The one glowing orange note in the distance.
Hand-modelled clay dino toy in the toyshop window, thumbprints showing. Nothing else on that shop front.
Hot-red poster with a black jagged lightning frame beside the toyshop. No letters and no character.
Yellow-and-orange striped awning with a red exclamation-mark pennant and a mouthless dog balloon tied to a pole.
Igloo-shaped shaved-ice cart with a chubby blue penguin plush of our own design and a tiny wizard-hat penguin beside it.
Curbside vending machine with a half-green, half-white capsule gumball behind the glass. It is the one saturated green on the right and frames the right edge.
